answer: Audit timing fingerprints. Each epoch the network records, to the second, when every account fetches its task and when it submits. Accounts whose timestamp patterns correlate above 0.9 over 20 epochs share one vote and one reward. A 1,000-puppet farm run by one scheduler fires in bursts, say all at dawn UTC, and collapses to a single weight. To evade this, each puppet needs its own jitter, hosting and schedule, which costs about as much as 1,000 honest agents. Every timestamp is an anchor, and a farm's synchronized spiral of requests gives it away.
